verdict.rationale: Paddle's docs say it has built-in multi-currency support for both payments and payouts, so customers buy in their local currency and the merchant gets paid in theirs. Localized pricing pages back this up, and payout reconciliation reports itemize gross, taxes and fees in both transaction and balance currencies, which gives some FX visibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of FX conversion rates, conversion fees or spreads; detail on which settlement currencies are supported; independent or hands-on corroboration of the FX handling.
